Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.results

Class MotionMetadata

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.results.MotionMetadata
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MotionMetadata extends Object implements Serializable
Metadata about the motion detection process and parameters used. Provides detailed information about how the motion analysis was performed.

This class captures all the configuration and statistical data from a motion detection operation, enabling debugging, optimization, and reproducibility of results.

      public int getThreshold()
      Threshold value used for motion detection (0-255). Pixels with difference above this value are considered changed.

      public boolean isGrayscaleUsed()
      Whether grayscale conversion was applied before analysis. Grayscale processing is faster and often sufficient for motion detection.

      Gaussian blur radius if blur was applied (0 = no blur). Blur helps reduce noise in motion detection.

      Whether morphological dilation was applied. Dilation helps connect nearby motion regions.
